landing.headline: Pick your favourite. Give what it's worth. See where it stands.
landing.subheader: Expressions of joy, for charitable causes, in the name of those we love.
landing.how.card.label: Scan or tap to open
landing.how.card.body: Scan a QR code on printed stationery at an event, or open a link someone shares with you.
landing.how.arrive.label: View the page
landing.how.arrive.body: favpoll details, the topic and chosen charities. Plus instructions to proceed.
landing.how.pick.label: Pick your favourite
landing.how.pick.body: Pick your favourite from the chosen topic. If yours is missing, add it. Can’t decide? Give to the shared fund instead.
landing.how.pledge.label: Pledge its worth
landing.how.pledge.body: Pledge what your favourite is worth to you. Give extra to the shared fund so others (e.g. children) can take part. Every penny goes to the chosen charity.
landing.how.reveal.label: Reveal its standing
landing.how.reveal.body: Standings appear, along with anything the favpoll was holding back.
landing.how.room.label: Watch it live
landing.how.room.body: Watch standings change as pledges land, on your phone or together on a large screen.
landing.how.keepsake.label: Print a keepsake
landing.how.keepsake.body: After the favpoll closes, print and share a memento of the favpoll, capturing all the detail that made it special.
landing.record.principle: Every pledge makes an eternal mark by feeding the record — all-time rankings for favpoll topics.
memorials.headline: Honour them by sharing what they loved. Give to charity in their memory.
memorials.subheader: One favpoll, as quiet or as present as the family wants — on the order of service, on a screen in the corner, or barely there at all.
memorials.cta.primary: Create a memorial favpoll — always free
memorials.how.title: How it works
memorials.how.pick.label: Pick
memorials.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic but they can participate without one.
memorials.how.pledge.label: Pledge
memorials.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to the chosen charity.
memorials.how.reveal.label: Reveal
memorials.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked along with the optional reveal.
memorials.assure.free.label: Free to set up
memorials.assure.free.body: No fees taken from the family or the gift.
memorials.assure.charity.label: 100% to charity
memorials.assure.charity.body: Pledges go to a registered charity, always.
memorials.assure.nofave.label: No favourite needed
memorials.assure.nofave.body: Guests without a pick can still give to the shared fund.
memorials.assure.phone.label: No app to install
memorials.assure.phone.body: Works in the browser on any phone, from a QR code.
memorials.pro.title: Celebrant, funeral director, or hospice?
memorials.pro.body: If you help families plan farewells, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
memorials.close.headline: In their honour, by their favourites.
memorials.artefacts.title: A few ideas
memorials.artefacts.pack.label: QR-coded order of service
memorials.artefacts.pack.body: Include the QR code on the order of service to cater for all guests, including those who may not attend the wake. Also eliminate the need for a collection box.
memorials.artefacts.reveal.label: Revealed favourite
memorials.artefacts.reveal.body: Revealing the favourite of a loved one is especially poignant for a memorial. Like a final word from them or a parting gift. It could be a direct quote, arranged long in advance.
memorials.artefacts.display.label: Quiet live display
memorials.artefacts.display.body: Display the favpoll in tribute mode at the wake. Let guests pledge in their own time and glance at the display rather than reach for their phone.
memorials.artefacts.keepsake.label: Tribute keepsake
memorials.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, invite guests to print and frame a tribute style keepsake as a lasting memory of your loved one.
celebrations.headline: Celebrate them by sharing what they love. Give to charity in their name.
celebrations.subheader: Birthdays, retirements, weddings — a favpoll gathers everyone around the guest of honour's favourite things, and turns the fun into pledges to a charity they choose.
celebrations.cta.primary: Create a celebration favpoll — always free
celebrations.how.title: How it works
celebrations.how.pick.label: Pick
celebrations.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic but they can participate without one.
celebrations.how.pledge.label: Pledge
celebrations.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to the chosen charity.
celebrations.how.reveal.label: Reveal
celebrations.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked along with the optional reveal.
celebrations.moment.title: A moment, not a chore
celebrations.moment.body: Share the QR code with the invitation, on the tables, or up on a screen. The reveal makes a natural beat in the speeches — then the party carries on.
celebrations.moment.line: It's a present everyone clubs together for — except the present is a donation, and the wrapping is a game.
celebrations.presence.title: From party game to centrepiece
celebrations.presence.ambient: Cards on the tables — guests play along between courses.
celebrations.presence.screen: The live standings on a screen — a horse race the whole room can watch.
celebrations.presence.rally: A goal to chase in their honour — the total ticking up all night.
celebrations.artefacts.title: A few ideas
celebrations.artefacts.cards.label: QR-coded place names
celebrations.artefacts.cards.body: Welcome each guest with a QR-coded place name on the table. Make the favpoll a feature of the occasion, inviting discussion between courses.
celebrations.artefacts.reveal.label: Surprise reveal
celebrations.artefacts.reveal.body: Add meaning to the reveal and create a talking point by making news of the chosen topic.
celebrations.artefacts.display.label: Live display centrepiece
celebrations.artefacts.display.body: Place the favpoll front and centre. Watch the standings move as pledges land, and let guests chase the goal through the evening.
celebrations.artefacts.keepsake.label: Keepsake
celebrations.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, print and send a keepsake to remember the occasion by.
celebrations.close.headline: For their big day, by their favourites.
fundraisers.headline: Fundraise by sharing what we all love. Give to charity in support of the cause.
fundraisers.subheader: A favpoll gives your supporters something to play for — everyone backs their favourite, and the room watches the total climb.
fundraisers.cta.primary: Create a fundraiser favpoll — always free
fundraisers.how.title: How it works
fundraisers.how.pick.label: Pick
fundraisers.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic but they can participate without one.
fundraisers.how.pledge.label: Pledge
fundraisers.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to the chosen charity.
fundraisers.how.reveal.label: Reveal
fundraisers.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked along with the optional reveal.
fundraisers.artefacts.title: A few ideas
fundraisers.artefacts.topic.label: A topic of your own
fundraisers.artefacts.topic.body: Nothing has to come from the catalogue. Write your own topic and your own list, and guests can add the one you never thought of.
fundraisers.artefacts.poster.label: QR-coded posters
fundraisers.artefacts.poster.body: Put a poster up wherever your supporters are — the office, the club, the shop window. Anyone who passes can scan it and take part, whether or not they know you.
fundraisers.artefacts.reveal.label: Revealed favourite
fundraisers.artefacts.reveal.body: Hold your own favourite back until someone has pledged. It gives supporters a reason to be first, and something to hold you to.
fundraisers.artefacts.keepsake.label: Thank-you keepsake
fundraisers.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, send everyone who took part a keepsake — the total raised, and where every favourite finished.
fundraisers.close.headline: For your cause, by their favourites.
